model.provenance: Root-provided dispatch; no independent serving attestation.

environment.GPR_PROJECT_PATH: The exact private lib/gnat directory may be prepended as in previous jobs; both direct imported projects use absolute paths. Do not select alternate dependencies.
environment.TMPDIR: Existing heavy worker chooses owned out/tmp. No RAM redirection is included/qualified here.

static_help_readback.executed: Installed gprbuild --help only; no target processing
static_help_readback.-u: Unique compilation, only compile the given files
static_help_readback.-p: Create missing obj, lib and exec dirs; intentionally omitted
static_help_readback.-U: Not used; this is not whole-source build/proof coverage

owned_output.creation: Root may create this exact new directory only after resource admission; do not run -p or create/alter imported output directories.
expected_classes: Actual compiler stdout/stderr and wrapper/source/terminal receipts
owned_output.budget_boundary: No empirical or enforced byte ceiling is established by this recipe. Source-unit selection bounds intended scope, not disk consumption. Root must allocate real scratch/receipt capacity before launch; existing reserve+60MB admission is unchanged.

preflight: Root resource window and existing heavy lock; actual8GiB/swap0 scope; unchanged reserve/admission and original deadline requirements.
Recheck project and all listed actual source/import hashes plus all134 private manifest rows before invoking the compiler.
Record installed compiler/GPR tool identities and runtime source binding; source-only recipe does not independently qualify installed runtime specs.
Confirm new object/output paths; no overlapping lane or automatic dependency rebuild.
Do not launch under a sampled50MB margin by bypassing the existing60MB admission guard.
readback_requirements: Exact command/target and strict compiler switches includinggnatc/gnatwe/gnata retained.
Actual exit0 and zero warnings/errors required for target compiler legality; retain every nonzero/partial outcome.
Before/after actual source and project hashes match.
Retain compiler diagnostics, output inventory, cgroup limits/peaks/events, result and inactive/unpopulated owned terminal-scope receipt.
Inspect imported project/output identities for unexpected writes; no whole dependency build is authorized.
nonclaims: No compiled legality inferred from source preparation.
No replay equivalence or productionPlan-to-Conforms bridge.
No production source, existing object, contract-pin, toolchain or assertion-policy change.
No F2/C1-C4/O1/integration/runtime or PhaseOne acceptance claim.
